meta.name: learn
meta.description: Distill a reusable skill from anything — a directory, a URL, pasted notes, or what you just did together — or refine an existing skill with new learnings. Use when the user says '/learn', 'learn this', 'turn this into a skill', 'capture this workflow', 'make a skill from <source>', or 'improve/update the <name> skill'. Produces or updates a .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md authored to NanoClaw's skill guidelines. (This CREATES or REFINES a skill from a source; it does not install existing skills from a registry.)

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从任何来源提炼或改进可复用的技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要把操作流程固化为可复用的技能
copy.tagline_en: Distill or refine a reusable skill from any source
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn workflows into reusable skills

howto.what: 把用户提供的目录、URL、笔记或对话内容提炼成一份技能说明,按 NanoClaw 指南生成 .claude/skills/<名称>/SKILL.md;若同名技能已存在,则就地更新而不是覆盖。
howto.when: 当你说出 '/learn'、'learn this'、'turn this into a skill' 等指令,或给出一个目录、URL、笔记要求做成技能,或要求改进某个已有的技能时触发。

say.note: 读取目录并生成技能文件。
把刚才的操作提炼成技能。

say.text: /learn 改进一下我的 demo 技能

howto.what_en: Distills a source (directory, URL, notes, or recent conversation) into a reusable skill file at .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md, or updates an existing skill in place.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user says '/learn', 'learn this', 'turn this into a skill', or similar, or asks to turn a directory/URL/notes/conversation into a skill, or to improve an existing skill.

say_en.note: Reads the directory and writes a skill file.
Distills the recent conversation into a skill.
